format: AM-014 exploratory inventory, not a production contract

coverage.reference_check: Markdown inline relative links outside fenced blocks; no anchor or runtime availability verification
limits: Not a complete external catalog inventory
Body reads record source inspection, not correct workflow execution
Absent metadata does not prove invocation unavailable
Historical files outside worktree are hashed, not copied

managed_skills.name: capture-observations
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: capture-observations
description: Record evidence-backed agent-work findings during the current task, such as a user correction, repeated failure, instruction conflict or reusable lesson. Use when such evidence arises or the user asks to save a finding. Do not open a reflection interview or change active instructions.

managed_skills.name: caveman
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: caveman
description: Use ultra-compressed wording only when the user explicitly requests caveman mode or invokes caveman. Preserve technical accuracy. Requests for concise, brief or fewer-token writing alone do not activate this mode.

managed_skills.name: chrome-devtools-axi
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: chrome-devtools-axi
description: Control and test web pages in a real Chrome browser through Chrome DevTools AXI. Use for browser interaction, UI verification, screenshots, console/network debugging and performance inspection. Skip plain HTTP retrieval and non-browser tasks. Respect an explicitly requested browser or tool.
metadata:
  author: Kun Chen (kunchenguid)
  hermes:
    tags: [browser, chrome, automation, devtools]
    category: automation

managed_skills.name: code-review
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: code-review
description: Reviews manual fixed points or immutable Review Unit Candidates on separate Standards, Spec, and Structural Quality axes. Candidate mode binds the exact workspace, provenance, and input hashes without creating Git refs.

managed_skills.name: conventions-aware-engineering
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: conventions-aware-engineering
description: Loads the smallest authoritative set of project documentation for an engineering task and resolves its scope, precedence, terminology, and verification rules. Use before architecture analysis, implementation, or code review in repositories with AGENTS.md, docs/agents/documentation-map.md, docs/conventions/, CONTEXT.md, or ADRs.

managed_skills.name: diagnose
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: diagnose
description: Diagnose reported bugs, errors, broken behavior and performance regressions. Build a faithful reproduction, identify the cause and verify a durable regression test before claiming a fix. Applies to simple and hard bugs; skip feature-only implementation and explanations without a reported failure.

managed_skills.name: gh-axi
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: gh-axi
description: "Operate GitHub through the gh-axi CLI - issues, pull requests, workflow runs, workflows, releases, repositories, labels, search, and raw API access. Use whenever a task touches GitHub: listing or filing issues, reviewing or merging PRs, checking CI runs, cutting releases, or querying the GitHub API."
user-invocable: false
author: Kun Chen (kunchenguid)
metadata:
  hermes:
    tags: [github, git, ci, pull-requests, releases]
    category: devops

managed_skills.name: grill-me
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: grill-me
description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree. Use when user wants to stress-test a plan, get grilled on their design, or mentions "grill me".

managed_skills.name: grill-with-docs
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: grill-with-docs
description: Use before turning a non-trivial implementation request into a spec or tickets when domain terms, scope, boundaries, or acceptance criteria remain unresolved. Also use when user explicitly wants to stress-test a plan against project docs. Skip clear small edits and approved specs or tickets.

managed_skills.name: handoff
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: handoff
description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.
argument-hint: "What will the next session be used for?"

managed_skills.name: implement
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: implement
description: Execute an approved spec or set of tickets within its agreed scope and acceptance, reusing recorded decisions and returning verification evidence. Use for artifact-based implementation, not discovery or artifact authoring.
disable-model-invocation: true

managed_skills.name: improve-codebase-architecture
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: improve-codebase-architecture
description: Finds deepening opportunities using routed project conventions, canonical domain language, and applicable ADRs. Use when improving architecture, consolidating tightly coupled modules, or making a codebase more testable and easier to navigate.

managed_skills.name: lavish
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: lavish
description: Create polished interactive HTML artifacts for annotation and feedback using Lavish when the user explicitly requests or accepts a hi-fi visual review. Do not activate from a plan, report, comparison or table request alone; skip low-fi visual exploration.
disable-model-invocation: true
metadata:
  hermes:
    tags: [html, review, artifacts, visualization]
    category: productivity

managed_skills.name: local-env
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: local-env
description: Prepares, starts, verifies, reuses, and closes isolated local environments using Portless for application HTTP and existing Docker SQL servers for existing or disposable databases. Use when running an application, integration/E2E tests, preparing a test database, or diagnosing local services. Do not use for tasks that need no running services.

managed_skills.name: mobile-next-android-testing
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: mobile-next-android-testing
description: Tests and diagnoses Android apps on connected physical devices or emulators through Mobile Next mobile-mcp tools, with ADB fallback, accessibility-first interaction, screenshots, recordings, and crash evidence. Use when a user asks to test, reproduce, inspect, automate, or debug an Android or mobile app on a device, or mentions ADB, Mobile Next, mobile-mcp, APKs, Android emulators, or a connected phone.

managed_skills.name: receiving-code-review
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: receiving-code-review
description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation

managed_skills.name: reflect
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: reflect
description: Review recorded observations, session lessons or agent instructions when the user explicitly requests reflection or review. Coordinate retrieval, specialist questions, evaluation and agreed proposals. Do not activate merely because an observation arises during work.
disable-model-invocation: true

managed_skills.name: repository-workflow
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: repository-workflow
description: Coordinate authorized changes in a Git repository through an owned worktree, configured environment, commits, verification evidence, PR preparation and post-merge cleanup. Use for repository implementation and resuming its delivery. Skip read-only reviews, explanation-only requests and non-Git work.

managed_skills.name: setup-conventions-aware-engineering
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: setup-conventions-aware-engineering
description: Guided setup for documentation routing, conventions, domain context, design, architecture, tracker guidance, and agent entry points. Adapts its proposal to greenfield and brownfield repositories.
disable-model-invocation: true

managed_skills.name: tdd
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: tdd
description: Implement features with behavior-first tests and a verified functional smoke, including when the user does not mention TDD. Also use for requested test-first bug fixes and integration tests. Skip explanation-only, read-only review and changes without runtime behavior.

managed_skills.name: thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review
description: Runs an explicit, unusually strict structural-quality review constrained by routed project conventions and ADRs. Use for thermo-nuclear review, deep maintainability audit, abstraction quality, giant files, or spaghetti-condition growth.
disable-model-invocation: true

managed_skills.name: to-spec
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: to-spec
description: Turn the current conversation into a reviewable spec — no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.
disable-model-invocation: true

managed_skills.name: to-tickets
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: to-tickets
description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker — edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker.
disable-model-invocation: true

managed_skills.name: triage
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: triage
description: Triage issues through a state machine driven by triage roles. Use when user wants to create an issue, triage issues, review incoming bugs or feature requests, prepare issues for an AFK agent, or manage issue workflow.

managed_skills.name: unslop
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: unslop
description: Cut AI tells from any writing. Must always apply.

managed_skills.name: verification-before-completion
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: verification-before-completion
description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always

managed_skills.name: visual-companion
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: visual-companion
description: Creates low-fidelity wireframes, diagrams, and structural visual comparisons for an explicitly requested visual exploration. Manual-only; use when user asks for a rough visual aid, wireframe, flow, or layout choice rather than a polished review surface.
disable-model-invocation: true

managed_skills.name: wayfinder
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: wayfinder
description: Plan a huge chunk of work — more than one agent session can hold — as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear.
disable-model-invocation: true

managed_skills.name: write-a-skill
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: write-a-skill
description: Create new agent skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and bundled resources. Use when user wants to create, write, or build a new skill.

managed_skills.name: zoom-out
managed_skills.frontmatter:
name: zoom-out
description: Tell the agent to zoom out and give broader context or a higher-level perspective. Use when you're unfamiliar with a section of code or need to understand how it fits into the bigger picture.
disable-model-invocation: true
